characters.summary: Ultra Sword Kirby wields an enormous glowing blade capable of slicing through massive obstacles, environmental hazards, and boss enemies with extreme physical force.

mechanisms: Invincibility frames during specific transformation/attack animations
Overwhelming offensive output that intercepts incoming attacks

weaknesses: Time limit on the Copy Ability duration before reverting to base Kirby
mobility: Standard movement with restricted jumping height while the heavy sword is held
limitations: Ability expires after a short duration or a fixed number of swings
characters.formDifferences: Temporarily replaces Kirby's standard inhale and ordinary copy abilities with a giant summonable sword that deals massive area-of-effect melee damage.

sources.supports: Details the Ultra Sword ability, its massive scale, and usage in Kirby's Return to Dream Land and later games.

feats.claim: Sliced a giant pillar and split a platform/boss in half using the Ultra Sword

notableResults.note: Used Ultra Sword during boss encounters

conditional.ability: Summoning and swinging the Ultra Sword
conditional.dependsOn: Encountering specific Super Ability enemies or designated areas in Kirby's Return to Dream Land

unknowns: Exact structural durability of the Ultra Sword blade when blocked by specialized magical shields is not fully quantified.
